title: ADA's Artifacts
description: Want some lore about a god that doesn't exist AND some cool stuff that add uses for the useless? Well, WELCOME, PAL!
body:
HEY, i'm The Oraaaaacle, and welcome to my world, Where useless things are usefull!!!

(Exept for the Useless One, like... he's really useless)



Here, YOU will find structures, challenges, items, foods, tools AAAAAAND...

Talk to ADA!!!
(through achivements and items)

But Now, HERE'S A PREVIEWWWWW!!!


.......


.......


OH.


WAIT.


It... 


It doesn't work.


WELL DON'T CARE, HERE'S A BORING DESCRIPTION OF WHAT YOU CAN FIND IN THIS MOD!


-AN ORE! that... THAT SPAWNS!
It's like, a crystal, but it's like, like Ada's crystal. You can found it inside Ada's rocks, in the air or on the floor.

-A ZINIT BERRY, THAT'S STONE!
Seriously, don't eat it.

-SOME NEW FOOD THAT'S BETTER THAN NOTHING!
Like, a use for the cookie, the betroot, the melon or the pumpkin, and EVEN THE BORING OLD BERRIES!!!!

-WEAPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!
Well, it... Shoots.
Some sort of crossbows, but you can like, hit with them. Yay.

-PAINTINGS!
Like... What did you expect?

-STRUCTURES TO HELP YA!!!
Go check the gallery for them.

-MOOOOOOOOB!!! WAAAAW!!
A One that gives you dust, and a Taller One that gives you a totem of undying, but is really hard to kill. By the way, be carefull about the bats.

AND SO MUCH MORE STUFF THAT I'VE COMPLETELY FORGOT ABOUT!!!


...


Ah, and ther's some lore too.




ANYWAY, HAPPY FLOCKLEPIELD! ORAAAAACLE OUT!
